arguments.body: Thank you for your email about the dog flap and the spare front door key. Two points: (1) Our earlier email said no issues were found. That was incomplete. The inspection report notes a dog flap fitted in the back door/utility room, and sticker-type marks on the Bedroom 1 wall that the tenant is to remove and make good. Please rely on the attached report, not that summary. (2) We are asking the tenant whether you agreed to the dog flap, whether the lock was changed and by whom, and where the spare key is. We will not take any action on the dog flap or the lock until we hear back and will update you by 22 February. If you have a record of any consent you gave or of who changed the lock, please send it. Please also tell us if you would like us to act on the dog flap in any particular way.
